title: Unbiased Evaluation of Large Language Models from a Causal Perspective
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of model and data bias in LLM benchmarks using a causal perspective. It utilizes standard benchmarks like MMLU, ARC-C, and GSM8K. While it contains a brief 'Impact Statement' regarding responsible AI, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as part of its core methodology or evaluation criteria.
